Hi Emma — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our side:

- Key pain: Finovo needs consistent low-latency inference for real-time analytics dashboards and tight cost predictability for production traffic.
- Scope we recommended: dedicated instance for query-heavy workflows + prefix KV caching for dashboard use-cases.
- Security note: we discussed SOC 2 scope and KMS integration (Grace will drive the evidence).

Next step: technical deep dive + demo for your engineering and security leads to validate performance and integration surface. We need to lock a 30–45 minute slot in the next 7 business days. To avoid back-and-forth, can you confirm one of these tight windows (all PT):

1) Tue May 4, 09:00–09:30 PT
2) Wed May 5, 11:00–11:30 PT

If neither works, reply with a 2-hour window of availability and we'll prioritize. Please confirm within 24 hours so we can get engineering on calendar.

I've attached our discovery notes and a preliminary SOW draft for details (high-level numbers only).

Attachments: discovery-notes-20260417.txt (text), Finovo_SOW_draft_v1.pdf (PDF)

Thanks — looking forward to progressing.

Best,
